warmup.interpretation: Warmup describes NUTS adaptation or random-walk burn-in. Random walk reports rejected nonfinite proposals; its NUTS event fields do not apply. These counts remain separate from convergence diagnostics and retained-draw warnings. Coverage: recorded = observed; not_run = known zero warmup; not_recorded = history unavailable. Unavailable or inapplicable counts are null in JSON and blank in Markdown, never zero. No warmup pass/fail rule is applied.
